tasks.label: Assemble Android debug APK directly
tasks.command: Set-Location 'C:\Users\www\Desktop\5A39~1\hasan_platform'; $env:JAVA_HOME='C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk-17.0.20.101-hotspot'; $env:ANDROID_HOME='C:\Users\www\AppData\Local\Android\Sdk'; $env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$env:ANDROID_HOME; & '.\android\gradlew.bat' app:assembleDebug -x lint -x test --configure-on-demand --build-cache -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a

tasks.label: Copy project to ASCII build path
tasks.command: if (Test-Path 'C:\hassan_build') { Write-Output 'C:\hassan_build already exists'; exit 0 }; robocopy 'C:\Users\www\Desktop\منصه البشمهندس حسن\hasan_platform' 'C:\hassan_build' /E /XD .git .expo android /XF '*.log' /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP; if ($LASTEXITCODE -lt 8) { exit 0 } else { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

tasks.label: Generate and build APK in ASCII path

tasks.label: Install built APK over USB
tasks.command: $adb='C:\Users\www\AppData\Local\Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe'; $apk='C:\hassan_build\android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk'; if (!(Test-Path $apk)) { Write-Error "APK not found: $apk"; exit 1 }; & $adb devices -l; & $adb install -r $apk
